method: Reverse DCF: bisection solves FCF growth g so PV of 10y FCF + terminal (g_term 2.5%) at 10% discount, plus net cash, equals last close (Jul 15 2026; LULU Jul 14, FISV Jul 10). Profitable positive-FCF names only. Excluded: pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names (OKLO, SMR/NuScale, IONQ, RGTI, D-Wave, Quantinuum, CRWV, NBIS, ASTS, HTZ, APLD, TE, OPEN) and banks/insurers (GS, JPM, SOFI). TTM FCF/shares/cash carried from the Jul 14 verified stockanalysis.com fetch; prices refreshed this run.
